description: This file contains the source code for the Security controller in the OpenCart admin panel, handling security-related functionalities such as listing security settings, managing storage locations, moving storage files, and installing security components.

classes.name: Security
classes.description: This class manages security functionalities within the admin panel, including listing security settings, managing storage paths, moving data, and installation routines.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the main security overview page, including security list and user token.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of security settings.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns a string representing the security configuration list, including checks for installation directories, storage paths, admin directory names, user permissions, and other security-related data.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Performs installation setup for security configurations, including permissions check, creating storage directories, migrating storage files, and updating configuration files.

methods.name: storage
methods.description: Handles storage configuration, including validating the storage directory, permission checks, and moving storage files.

methods.name: storage
methods.description: Handles storage configuration, including validating the storage directory, permission checks, and moving storage files.

methods.name: admin
methods.description: Prepares the security management page, handling permission checks, directory validations, and navigation links.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles the deletion of security-related files or directories, such as removing storage or admin directories, and updating related configuration files.
